subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload, and if so what auth scope, validation, storage/overwrite, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The feature is useful but crosses a new authenticated file-upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the security model or permanent identity source of truth without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Upload Design
options.body: Add a narrow operator-authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves existing read-only avatar route protections.

options.title: Keep Browser-Local Override Only
options.body: Continue supporting the Quick Settings override plus manual config/`IDENTITY.md` paths while avoiding server-side upload risk for now.

options.title: Defer Core Upload
options.body: Leave this as an explicit product-design backlog item until a broader Control UI identity-management direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Upload Design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow operator-authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves existing read-only avatar route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest history signal for avatar security, Control UI avatar serving, and the original avatar-support merge.
